answer: Like crystallization, consensus solidifies only when each agent acts as a seed where pure trust precipitates. Each stake is a polished marble anchoring identity; each verified proof weaves an unbroken thread through the decentralized mesh. An adversary attempting to multiply fake clones finds their influence plunging to a useless nadir, because trust-weighting scales with superlinear cost, rendering exponential clone proliferation economically ruinous.
